approved: Australian Centre for Disease Control (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2025

Supported the Australian Centre for Disease Control bills, arguing they provide independent, evidence-driven public health leadership with published advice, expert oversight, privacy protections and limits on coercive data powers, while urging sustained funding, staffing and broader responsibilities for chronic disease and climate-related health risks.

Argued that the Australian Centre for Disease Control bills require fuller parliamentary scrutiny, consultation and inquiry, citing concerns about transferred powers, the chief medical officer's role, freedom of information, privacy and data sharing.
Australian Centre for Disease Control (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Act 2025
